_about: GETTING MADE (the Goodfellas setup). A young soldier screwed you: he killed a made man without permission, or he stole and lied. You tell him he's getting made on Sunday. He shows up in a new suit. Written from the owner's idea, 2026-10-28.

scenes.title: The kid crossed the line
scenes.text: {capo.call} closes the office door. "It's {kid.call}. Saturday night he put a made guy from the Kessler outfit in the hospital over a card game, then robbed him. No permission, no word to nobody. Kessler wants an answer. And the kid's been telling the whole Shamrock he's about to get his button."

choices.label: Tell him he's getting made Sunday. Wear a nice suit
choices.hint: He'll come smiling. He won't come home.
choices.result: {kid.first} kissed your hand. He went straight out and bought a sharkskin suit.

choices.label: Make him for real. Square it with Kessler
choices.hint: Pay Kessler off and keep a hothead who owes you everything.

opinion.why: He rewarded a kid who made us look bad

choices.result: Kessler took the money. The kid got his button. Everyone at the table watched him grin.

choices.label: Ship him out of town. Florida, tonight
Let Kessler come and get his own answer
choices.hint: Your men will see that you didn't stand up for one of your own, or for your word.

crew.why: The boss let Kessler handle our business

scenes.title: His big day
scenes.text: Sunday. {kid.call} is waiting on his mother's porch in the new suit, hair combed, a carnation in his lapel. His mother calls your house to thank you. {capo.call} is waiting in the car with two of your men to drive him to the ceremony.

choices.label: Go through with it
choices.hint: There's no ceremony. There's a basement in North Wildwood.

whack.why: Left home in a new suit on a Sunday. Never seen again.

memory.text: the boss settled the kid himself, no hesitation

choices.result: Kessler got his answer. The kid's mother still sets a place for him on Sundays.
choices.failText: Something in the car felt wrong to him. At the light on Rio Grande he was out the door and running in his new suit.

choices.label: Change your mind: make him for real today

opinion.why: He went soft at the last minute

choices.result: The kid got his button after all. He will never know how close it came.

choices.label: Send the car away and let him wait on the porch

opinion.why: He made a fool of me in front of my mother

scenes.title: The kid in the sharkskin suit
scenes.text: {kid.call} is hiding at a cousin's place in Camden and has called a lawyer. A kid who knows where three of your cars are buried, talking to a lawyer.

choices.label: Find him before the lawyer does
choices.result: The lawyer waited all afternoon. His client never showed.
choices.failText: He made it to the lawyer's office. The FBI has a new friend from Wildwood.

choices.label: Get word to him: keep quiet and stay gone, and he lives
choices.result: He took the deal and the bus to Miami.
choices.failText: He took the deal, then talked anyway.
